title: Research: rule out uniform dirty-padding exchange adapters
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2636's aggregate padding scan requires fresh output. This note proves that a specific borrowed-workspace replacement cannot work: uniform bank XORs, additive padding/restriction, and full padded exchanges cannot exchange one genuine bank while restoring every arbitrary dirty bank. The result covers every `[P,Q,G,Q,S]` rectangle with `Q>=2` and nonempty binary padding, any finite bank count, and any finite word length.

A determinant invariant on a genuine two-cycle and a padding two-cycle gives the complete argument. A seven-gate adapter demonstrates the failure: useful output is correct, but borrowed padding moves. The unpadded case and a changed masked-exchange alphabet provide positive controls. This closes an unbounded search in the stated alphabet and identifies the ownership/primitive decision a physical adapter must make.

**Scoped negative result, no new kappa.** PR2636 explicitly assumes fresh output and is not refuted. Other coordinate maps, masked exchanges, clean/disposable storage, nonlinear operations, and payload-dependent control are outside the theorem. No selected frontier or upstream source changes.

## Task and overlap

Base `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30`; task `01a1335e-7a24-73c3-a549-9bcb5496a363`; OS seed 3, bit supplier. Scope changes from the H2/K helper card to a dirty-padding boundary; it is not an H2/K replacement. The verified work continued after an interruption without another scope or seed.

Nearest sources: PR2457 at `0362534712dca8639917a733be62840d5ce55978` and PR2636 at `c1e173b7af38603bc7660a8829e75006e93645d3`. Current main, source heads, 751 open PR bodies, and recent Discussion claims were refreshed before submission. Broader cached Discussion coverage is explicitly stale. PR677 supplies the prior group-ring determinant method; this adds the simultaneous genuine/padding invariant. PR679's separate unused-lane inverse changes the alphabet and remains outside this result.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dirty-padding-exchange-boundary
```

CPython3.15 primary checks and the explicitly pinned CPython3.12 compatibility replay pass. Five literal full-bit matrix closures each exhaust 96 operators and 288 edges without determinant pruning. A separate generic ring-matrix implementation checks 81 primitives and 160 seeded words, plus the empty-bank case. Another 500 shapes check orbit hypotheses. Optimized Git-free controls reject omitted exchange, omitted restriction, and actual source corruption. Metadata, source pins, and the original card baseline pass.

The uniform theorem rests on the written proof; finite checks corroborate it. Both implementations share an AI author. No external human review, formal proof kernel, physical callee, full selected cold replay, or hosted CI pass is claimed.

## Credit and next question

Credit ywz65's PR2457/2636 lineage, commdata2338's PR677 method, Greer Guthrie's PR679 analysis, and their predecessors. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

The next useful step is a source-bound physical callee that fixes the padding complement, or a fully priced fresh-output contract. Its heads, scratch ownership, caller parking, and complete cost must be specified before more construction work.
